title: The claimed N1'' rail-on zoom/pan/pullback pins do not bite — reverting play_w→win_w in camera_zoom_at/effect_pan/pullback_feed keeps the entire app suite green
evidence:
effect_zoom(&app, &app.input, 1, {300, 360}) // a playfield point (off the plate)
testing.expect(t, app.cam_zoom_to != before, "rail on: the wheel still zooms (the anchor math reads play_w)")
...
effect_pan(&app, &app.input, 60, 0)
testing.expect(t, app.cam_wx_to != bx || app.cam_wy_to != by, "rail on: the pan moves the camera (the clamp reads play_w)")
...
testing.expect(t, app.pullback, "rail on: a distant seed still triggers the pullback (the target math reads play_w)")
— Mutation run on the reviewed tree: reverting f32(v.play_w)→f32(v.win_w) at main.odin:1830/1891-1892/1919 → "Finished 42 tests in 2.914ms. All tests were successful."
detail: The asserts' own messages claim "the anchor/clamp/target math reads play_w" but only pin that the effects still function (routing), not play_w bounds. Only camera_update's leg is sensitive; a silent win_w reintroduction at all three input sites ships green.
recommended_fix: Assert play_w-sensitive values, not '!= before': pan-60 target == 832-60/(fit*2) exactly; after rail-on zoom, camera_update-converged world right edge <= play_w; pullback target district inside the play_w viewport.

title: The crisis banner's play_w re-anchor (crisis.odin centering + card-width clamp) has zero biting coverage — full revert stays green; the hud_test rail-on leg is a vacuous formula copy
evidence:
crisis.odin:63 & :84: x := (v.play_w - card_w) / 2 // the playfield center (DOCK-RIGHT: clear of the rail)
hud_test.odin:	cw = crisis_card_width(&w)
	right = (f32(w.play_w) + f32(cw)) / 2 + f32(hud(&w, 10))
	testing.expect(t, right <= f32(w.play_w), "rail on: the x1.50 banner stays inside the playfield")
— Mutation run: reverting both x sites to v.win_w AND restoring the old width clamp → "Finished 75 tests in 8.203ms. All tests were successful." grep crisis_banner_rect across *_test.odin: zero matches.
detail: The rail-on leg re-derives the right edge from its own formula instead of reading crisis_banner_rect, so it passes under any revert (at 1280×1.5 the by_playfield clamp never engages: 660<726). A reverted banner also re-creates swallowed clicks (crisis_banner_click runs after the plate swallow).
recommended_fix: Pin crisis_banner_rect at rail-on by reading the rect: r.x + r.width <= play_w and centered on play_w/2; rail off byte-identical to the win_w center. Stop formula-copying the right-edge math.

title: The stats_valid gate on the press-swallow (the r3 N2'' fix branch) ships unpinned — removing the gate keeps all 42 app tests green
detail: The B1'' fix's tray-yield and swallow legs bite (verified by mutation), but its stats_valid gate — the N2'' no-clicks-eaten-over-an-undrawn-plate branch — has no false-path leg.
recommended_fix: Add a leg: overlay_on + stats_valid=false + a plate-point press → effect_ui_press returns false (falls through, matching the undrawn plate).

title: view_refit — new public API added by this diff — has no test; its rail-on path (the harness verbs' fit-to-rail parity) never runs under odin test
detail: The rail-on refit is exactly what makes the PP_DEBUG D-on captures match the app's frame; a drift between view_refit and camera_update-at-center would only surface in dev captures, never in CI.
recommended_fix: Pin view_refit at rail-on: off_x == (play_w - world_w*scale)/2, equal to camera_update's converged transform at the world center (the parity contract).
